message: VIX 15 (down-cross) = calm regime. MEANING: insurance is cheap again + your Nov 710 put is bleeding with no catalyst. ACTION: (1) tranche-2 add window is LIVE per plan if Aug 10-21 (spread structure, margin acct/main broker only); (2) review the put's salvage math - if SPY is also >760, thesis is delayed, consider cutting half.

VIX 14 (down-cross) = thesis running too far AGAINST the Nov 710 put. ACTION: combined with SPY >765 this is the pre-agreed CUT signal - salvage remaining premium on half or all; being early is fine, riding to zero is not. Log exit in calls-ledger 2026-07-31-SPY-put-tranche1.

VIX 20 (up-cross) = first break signal for the correction thesis. ACTION: no trade yet - verify breadth (SPY vs 735 shelf, USDJPY, credit). If SPY <735 same week, thesis is WORKING - hold put, review tranche 2 pricing before it gets expensive.

VIX 28 (up-cross) = PANIC ZONE = pre-registered EXIT for the Nov 710 put (plan: sell into panic VIX 28-30). ACTION: SELL the put into strength NOW - do not wait for more; panic marks are the trade's whole payday. Log fill + grade vs the 14.87 entry.

SPY 765 (up-cross) = +2.4% above the 7/31 entry tape = correction thesis materially against us. ACTION: pair with VIX - if VIX <14 too, CUT half/all of the Nov 710 put and bank salvage; if VIX still >16, market is climbing nervous - hold per plan (flat by early Nov regardless).

USDJPY 155 (down-cross) = yen-carry TREMOR became a QUAKE (fell from 162 against a widening rate gap = forced deleveraging risk, Aug-2024 pattern). ACTION: this is the accelerant scenario for the 10-20% correction - hold/size-review the Nov put, tighten attention on stock stops, expect fast tape. Not an auto-trade, a regime alarm.
